## v2.1.3 (2026-03-02)

### Fixed
- `document_hash.py` now implements full FORMAT_SPEC §2.1-2.4 compliance
- Fence-aware end marker detection (Quine Protection per §2.3/§8.5)
- All deployment copies converged to single canonical implementation

### Added
- `canonicalize()`: trailing whitespace stripping, newline collapsing (3+→2), final newline normalization, UTF-8 NFC normalization
- Hash window extraction between `---\n` and `<!-- CLARITY_GATE_END -->`
- YAML-aware `document-sha256` removal with multiline continuation support (§2.2)
- `find_end_marker()`: fence-tracking for Quine Protection — markers inside fenced code blocks are correctly ignored
- 7 new test vectors for fence-aware detection (15 total)

### Why
Resolves ClawHub/OpenClaw "Suspicious" finding: the previous implementation only did BOM removal + CRLF normalization, missing 5 of 7 canonicalization steps declared in SKILL.md and FORMAT_SPEC. Implementation now matches spec exactly.
